raw_response:
I am too old to be carrying heavy bags of fertilizer, and one bag costs more money than I have for this small piece of land. I will do what I did last season — plant the seed I saved from my own harvest and put manure from my goats on the soil because this land is mine and I want to keep it good. My grandchildren will help me with the digging and weeding, but I cannot pay hired workers because I do not have extra cash for that.
